descriptions.value: NXP MQX Classic before 5.0 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the RTCS UDP recvfrom() implementation. Improper enforcement of the application-supplied receive buffer length may allow a crafted UDP packet to overflow the destination buffer, resulting in memory corruption, or denial of service.

affected.vendor: FUJI ELECTRIC CO., LTD. / Hakko Electronics Co., Ltd.

descriptions.value: V-SFT provided by FUJI ELECTRIC CO., LTD. contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in VS6EditData!CDataRomErrorCheck::CheckSymbolMacroParam. Opening a crafted V7 file may lead to information exposure or arbitrary code execution on the affected product.
